subject: Paraprofessional Contract Ratification
overview: The School Committee ratified a new multi-year contract for paraprofessionals and authorized the expansion of after-school program staffing. The approved measures support the district's implementation of an extended school day and aim to reduce enrollment waitlists.

items.title: Executive Session Entry
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to discuss collective bargaining strategy for contracts with paraprofessionals, nurses, and cafeteria workers.

items.title: Paraprofessional Contract Ratification
items.summary: Approved the ratification of one-year and three-year contracts for paraprofessionals, which facilitate an extended school day and provide livable wage increases. The agreement includes flexible staffing for bus monitoring and after-school events to improve student safety and family engagement.

items.title: After School Site Coordinator Positions
items.summary: Approved increasing two after-school site coordinator positions from part-time to full-time status to manage expanding program capacity. Suzanne Galusi noted the change is funded by a revolving account and supports coordination with an expanded City Year partnership.
